mechanics.title: Sneak-use repair
mechanics.description: Sneak + right-click with a Mending item to spend your own XP to repair it.

qol: Repair Mending items on demand with banked XP
commands_and_keybinds: Sneak (default Shift) + right-click while holding a Mending item
getting_started: Hold a damaged Mending tool or armor piece, crouch and right-click.
editor_notes: XP cost per durability point is not documented in the source. Required on server; client optional. The draft's claim about repairing non-held items is unsupported.
name: Better Than Mending
summary: Sneak and right-click while holding an item with Mending to repair it using experience you already have, instead of waiting for orbs to be collected.
